```yaml
name: Lint and Roadmap Validation

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install linting dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install flake8 black isort mypy

      - name: Lint with flake8
        run: |
          # Stop the build if there are Python syntax errors or undefined names
          flake8 . --count --select=E9,F63,F7,F82 --show-source --statistics
          # Exit-zero treats all errors as warnings. The GitHub editor is 127 chars wide
          flake8 . --count --exit-zero --max-complexity=10 --max-line-length=127 --statistics

      - name: Check formatting with black
        run: |
          black --check .

      - name: Check import sorting with isort
        run: |
          isort --check-only --diff .

  validate-roadmap:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Validate docs/roadmap.md structure
        run: |
          # Ensure the file exists
          if [ ! -f "docs/roadmap.md" ]; then
            echo "Error: docs/roadmap.md not found"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Check for required new sections mentioned in the request
          # Note: This is a basic validation to ensure the roadmap expansion is present
          REQUIRED_SECTIONS=(
            "Document Understanding Tasks"
            "Data Augmentation"
            "Modeling"
            "Benchmarking"
            "Developer Experience"
          )

          for section in "${REQUIRED_SECTIONS[@]}"; do
            if ! grep -qi "$section" docs/roadmap.md; then
              echo "Warning: Section '$section' not found in docs/roadmap.md"
            fi
          done

          # Check for specific keywords related to the request
          KEYWORDS=(
            "table structure recognition"
            "key-value extraction"
            "SynthDoG"
            "quantization"
            "ONNX"
            "TRT"
            "robustness benchmarks"
            "commercial API comparison"
            "unified CLI"
            "model cards"
          )

          for keyword in "${KEYWORDS[@]}"; do
            if ! grep -qi "$keyword" docs/roadmap.md; then
              echo "Warning: Keyword '$keyword' not found in docs/roadmap.md"
            fi
          done

          echo "Roadmap validation completed."
```
